routeOnOriginMain.answer: YES - U5g's route is on origin/main as of 53bd8f0a8. It is NOT on this unit's baseline 145e15560 (`git ls-tree HEAD -- src/pages-modules/api/matchHeadRoute.ts` printed nothing); U5h's adapter IS on this baseline. The head fetch is faked in Jest in every suite this unit touches, so no live route is needed locally.

design.product: buildGmRewindRequest (useGmRewindProducers.ts) reads the head outcome's digest through a `string | undefined` binding - no cast - and refuses the head when that value is not a non-empty string, returning null so every caller reports `unavailable` and posts nothing. When it is a non-empty string it becomes expectedDigest on the built request, replacing the '' literal and its stale WHY comment.
design.correctionPath: no product change in useGmCorrectionProducers.ts: the approve arm already forwards the pinned request, so it now carries branch, revision, generation and digest plus the private reason by construction.
design.whyRefuseRatherThanSendEmpty: the correction lease compares expectedDigest against the journal head (EventHistoryCorrectionLeaseContract), and an empty claim is refused as correction-lease-held; posting '' would spend a request that cannot commit.

redPlan: (a) EXPECTED_BODY / EXPECTED_REQUEST pin expectedDigest === the faked head's 64-hex digest in both hook suites (red today: '').
(b) the correction approve row asserts commit received that same request plus the reason (red today: expectedDigest '').

(c) a head outcome whose digest is absent (the pre-U5h shape) or empty yields `unavailable` and posts nothing. The adapter itself filters those bodies, so the row hands the producer that outcome directly through a jest.mock spy that otherwise delegates to the real adapter; a global.fetch-only row would be green today and would not be red evidence.
(d) the lobby page test's preview and confirm rows pin the faked head's digest (red today: '').
